steps.meaning: The council votes on Ordinance 2026-14 at the 8 September session.
steps.name: vote_occurs

steps.meaning: The regular session on 8 September 2026 takes place as scheduled.
steps.name: session_held

steps.meaning: Ordinance 2026-14 is on the published agenda for the 8 September session.
steps.name: item_on_agenda

steps.meaning: The sponsor does not move postponement of the item.
steps.name: no_postponement
steps.uncertainty: Okonkwo, the sponsor, may decide to move postponement.

steps.meaning: At least three council members are physically present in the chamber to vote.
steps.name: quorum_present

steps.meaning: Adaeze Okonkwo is physically present in the chamber at the time of the vote.
steps.name: okonkwo_present
steps.uncertainty: Okonkwo may choose to attend or not.

steps.meaning: Minh Tran is physically present in the chamber at the time of the vote.
steps.name: tran_present
steps.uncertainty: Tran may choose to attend or not.

steps.meaning: Rosa Delgado is physically present in the chamber at the time of the vote.
steps.name: delgado_present
steps.uncertainty: Delgado may choose to attend or not.

steps.meaning: Gareth Pryce is physically present in the chamber at the time of the vote.
steps.name: pryce_present
steps.uncertainty: Pryce may choose to attend or not.

steps.meaning: Carla Bianchi is physically present in the chamber at the time of the vote.
steps.name: bianchi_present
steps.uncertainty: Bianchi has filed notice of absence, but may still attend.

steps.meaning: At least three council members vote affirmatively on Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: affirmative_votes_at_least_three

steps.meaning: Adaeze Okonkwo votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: okonkwo_vote_yes
steps.uncertainty: Okonkwo has stated support, but may change her vote.

steps.meaning: Minh Tran votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: tran_vote_yes
steps.uncertainty: Tran has stated he is prepared to vote for it, but may change his vote.

steps.meaning: Rosa Delgado votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: delgado_vote_yes
steps.uncertainty: Delgado has stated opposition, but may change her vote.

steps.meaning: Gareth Pryce votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: pryce_vote_yes
steps.uncertainty: Pryce has stated opposition, but may change his vote.

steps.meaning: Carla Bianchi votes in favor of Ordinance 2026-14.
steps.name: bianchi_vote_yes
steps.uncertainty: Bianchi has stated support, but may change her vote; also she may be absent.
